note: Saluda County publishes no county-wide zoning districts; its public ArcGIS MapServer (PublicWebsite_Pro) has parcels, flood, districts and town limits but no zoning layer. The Town of Saluda, the city-level zoner, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (ArcMap export, 2016) and an image-based map page, with no queryable district service found in ArcGIS Online either.
